spec.name: sprint33_taker_imbalance_majors_mom
spec.hypothesis: Short-horizon taker buy/sell volume imbalance (order-flow imbalance, not price-based) predicts continuation in the top-of-book liquid majors (BTCUSD, ETHUSD) over a 5-10min hold, net of T1 costs -- distinct mechanism from the price-based mean-reversion/breakout signals that failed on tail-liquidity alts in sprint31/32.
spec.power_argument: BTCUSD+ETHUSD trade continuously with tight spreads (unlike the alt basket, where -25 to -34bps mean_net at t~-20 in sprint31/32 was cost bleed, not signal absence). At entry_per_day_cap=12 across 2 symbols over the sprint window, expect n>=300+ trades. Assuming short-horizon return stdev ~60-70bps (majors, 5-10min), min detectable edge at t=2, n=300 is ~2*65/sqrt(300)=7.5bps -- achievable given T1 round-trip cost (~2-4bps) is far below the alt-basket cost regime that killed 31/32.
